title: The D23 grader stages the patch and the stored patches are regraded
body:
Why: D3 claims evals/d23/grade.ts:244 git apply lacks --index; lead verification found no later step relying on the index (only :123/:142 checkouts), so first reproduce a lost unit before changing it; then regrade stored patches with no model session.
Evidence: .krn/runs/state-review/decisions.md (state review 2026-11-13, Fable 5.2; data verified by the lead where noted), .krn/runs/state-review/portability-probe.md.
Source: operator 2026-11-13 ordered the state-review decisions executed ('lecisz z tym wszystkim').
